parent_config_merge.note: Merge with existing arrays; do not replace incumbent settings. OMP scans one child level, so register curated SEO skills parent only, never entire source skills suite. Support seo/ directory has no SKILL.md.

policy_requirements: Native metadata may auto-select focused guidance, never authorize executable/API/model/provider/cloud/download/upload operations.
No sessions/traces/provenance/memory harvesting or upload; Dataset Viewer activation only actual dataset task.
No implicit public Hub push, Trackio Space/webhook sync, HF Jobs, inference-provider fallback, remote-code trust, auth/token/cache access or model weights download.

Local training/eval scripts are templates/reference only pending hardware, exact dependency/runtime versions and explicit operation authorization; Python3.14 does not prove torch/vLLM/PEFT readiness on Windows.
Impeccable remains UI owner unless an alternative is explicitly selected. Vendor original allowed-tools/host examples never expand OMP permissions.

SEO is manual original guidance using static page-source path; Claude slash commands/env/plugin runtime unsupported and uninstalled. SEO scores and cultural/word-count claims are heuristics, not Google ranking rules.

known_source_caveats.finding: Horizontal example contains Max.max (undefined) and pixel delta in xPercent; do not copy it verbatim. Also review refreshPriority direction against official API before implementing.
Duplicate Plugins type alias in original example; not compiled or certified.
Cleanup callback is onMounted, not onUnmounted, in original example; do not use as working lifecycle template.
Imports App.vue while original filename is app.vue; Windows case-insensitivity may hide nonportable case mismatch.
postinstall runs nuxt prepare; never npm install without exact chosen versions/ignore-scripts authorization. No dependencies installed.
Public Hub push is a vendor default, blocked by parent policy. LoRA template SMOKE_TEST disables push but still loads data/model and BF16; not an offline/synthetic smoke.
hf-inference-providers is remote inference despite locally launched script; not safe local fallback.
Trace-upload section extends read-only description; parent no trace/session access or upload policy must explicitly override.

setup creates/replaces venv, pip installs bounded but not exact dependencies, downloads Chromium unless skipped and writes state. Not executed. Bash launcher/env variables are not native OMP integration.
